label: Contentful
description: Read entries, assets, and content types across spaces and environments, and comment on entries.
securityDescription: Contentful sign-in opens through Composio. Agents act as the signed-in Contentful user and can read the spaces, environments, entries, assets, content types, locales, releases, version history, and taxonomy that user can reach. With write access, Agents can comment on entries and restore an archived entry to draft. A comment is visible to everyone who can open the entry. Agents cannot create, edit, publish, unpublish, archive, or delete entries or assets, change content types, locales, tags, or editor layouts, create spaces or environments, assign tasks, schedule releases, read API keys, app secrets, or webhook logs, or manage roles, memberships, webhooks, or apps.

drop.CONTENTFUL_CREATE_CONTENT_TYPE: Changes the content model that every editor and delivery client relies on.
drop.CONTENTFUL_CREATE_ENTRY_TASK: Assigns work to a named space member, who is notified; other connectors do not assign.
drop.CONTENTFUL_CREATE_ENVIRONMENT: Copies a whole environment and counts against the space's plan limit.
drop.CONTENTFUL_CREATE_LOCALE: Locales are space configuration that changes every entry's editable fields.
drop.CONTENTFUL_CREATE_SPACE: A new space can add to the organization's bill.
drop.CONTENTFUL_CREATE_SPACES_ENVIRONMENTS_EX: A UI extension runs custom code in every editor's browser.
drop.CONTENTFUL_GET_ORGANIZATIONS_AI_PROVIDER: Organization AI provider configuration; not content.
drop.CONTENTFUL_GET_ORGANIZATIONS_APP_DEF_EVE: App event subscriptions name delivery URLs; not content.
drop.CONTENTFUL_GET_ORGANIZATIONS_ROLES: Role and permission administration; not content.
drop.CONTENTFUL_GET_SPACES_API_KEYS: Returns Content Delivery API access tokens.
drop.CONTENTFUL_GET_SPACES_ENVIRONMENTS_APP_I: App installation parameters can hold credentials.
drop.CONTENTFUL_GET_SPACE_MEMBERSHIPS: Membership and role administration; not content.
drop.CONTENTFUL_GET_WEBHOOK_CALLS: Webhook call logs carry request bodies and headers sent to outside URLs.
drop.CONTENTFUL_LIST_SPACES_ROLES: Role and permission administration; not content.
drop.CONTENTFUL_LIST_WEBHOOKS: Webhook definitions name outside URLs and headers; not content.
drop.CONTENTFUL_PROCESS_ASSET: Processes an uploaded file, and asset upload is not included.
drop.CONTENTFUL_UPDATE_CONTENT_TYPE: Changes the content model that every editor and delivery client relies on.
drop.CONTENTFUL_UPDATE_EDITOR_INTERFACE: Changes the editing layout for everyone in the space.
drop.CONTENTFUL_UPDATE_LOCALE: Locale settings control which languages the delivery API serves.
drop.CONTENTFUL_UPDATE_SPACE: Renames the space for everyone in it; space administration.
drop.CONTENTFUL_UPDATE_SPACES_ENVIRONMENTS_TA: Tags cannot be applied to entries without an entry update tool, and tag administration is not content work.

capabilities.description: Tool to retrieve all entries from a Contentful space environment. Use when you need to list, search, or filter content entries. Supports pagination, sorting, field selection, and filtering by content type or custom fields.

skip.description: Number of entries to skip for pagination

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return per page (default: 100, max: 1000)

order.description: Sort results by a specified field (e.g., 'sys.createdAt' or '-fields.name' for reverse order)

query.description: Full-text search query to filter entries

locale.description: Retrieve content in specified language/region code

select.description: Comma-separated list of specific fields to return (e.g., 'sys.id,fields.title'). Supports depth of 2 levels maximum.

include.description: Number of levels to resolve linked entries and assets (0-10, default: 1)

space_id.description: ID of the space containing the entries

content_type.description: Filter entries by content type ID. Required when filtering by custom fields.

environment_id.description: ID of the environment containing the entries (typically 'master')

input.description: Request model for listing entries in a Contentful space environment.

capabilities.description: Lists all environments of a space in Contentful, including the master environment and any custom environments. Use this action when you need to discover available environments within a space for content management operations. Supports pagination for spaces with many environments.

skip.description: Number of environments to skip for pagination (default: 0)

limit.description: Maximum number of environments to return per page (default: 25, max: 1000)

space_id.description: ID of the space to list environments from

input.description: Request model for listing all environments of a space in Contentful.

capabilities.description: Lists all spaces that the authenticated user has access to in Contentful. This is a fundamental operation needed before performing any other content management actions since most operations require a space ID. To paginate, increment `skip` by `limit` across successive calls; stop when the returned count is less than `limit`.

skip.description: Number of spaces to skip for pagination

limit.description: Maximum number of spaces to return (default: 100, max: 1000)

input.description: Request model for listing spaces in Contentful.

capabilities.description: Tool to retrieve multiple assets with pagination and filtering via GraphQL API. Use when you need to query assets from Contentful with advanced filtering, sorting, and locale selection. Supports preview mode and fallback locale options.

withheldArguments.access_token: carries a credential the model would supply itself

skip.description: Zero-indexed offset in the collection from which items are fetched. Default is 0

limit.description: Maximum number of items to fetch. Default is 100, maximum is 1000

order.description: Order specifications to apply on the collection query. Example: ['sys_firstPublishedAt_ASC', 'sys_id_DESC']

locale.description: Locale for the collection items. If not set, the default locale is used. Example: 'en-US'

preview.description: When set to true, returns non-published content. Default is false

space_id.description: ID of the space to query assets from

use_fallback_locale.description: When set to false, fields without a value in the requested locale return null instead of the fallback locale. Default is true

input.description: Request model for querying asset collection via GraphQL in Contentful.

capabilities.description: Tool to query a collection of entries for a specific content type using GraphQL. Use when you need to fetch multiple entries with filtering, sorting, pagination, or preview mode. The query field name must be the camelCase content type ID with 'Collection' suffix (e.g., 'blogPostCollection').

withheldArguments.access_token: carries a credential the model would supply itself

query.description: GraphQL query string. Must be in the format: { contentTypeIdCollection { items { sys { id } fieldName } } }. The content type ID should be in camelCase with 'Collection' suffix. Example: '{ testArticleCollection { items { sys { id publishedAt } title } } }'

space_id.description: ID of the Contentful space

environment_id.description: ID of the environment (optional, omit for default environment). Use 'master' for production environment.

input.description: Request model for querying a collection of entries for a specific content type via GraphQL.

capabilities.description: Tool to unarchive an entry in Contentful, restoring it to active status. Use when you need to restore an archived entry to make it available for editing and publishing. The entry must be currently archived. You may need to provide the X-Contentful-Version header matching the entry's current version.

entry_id.description: ID of the entry to unarchive

space_id.description: ID of the space containing the entry

environment_id.description: ID of the environment containing the entry (typically 'master')

X-Contentful-Version.description: Version of the entry to unarchive. Required for version control. Use the current version number of the entry.

input.description: Request model for unarchiving an entry in Contentful.
